static_traits.name: Ai Lin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members in the city
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to talk with, but they cannot always provide support when needed; interpersonal connections are relatively shallow
static_traits.medical_history: Has not experienced similar problems; no other psychotherapy history; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively good logic, steady tone and cooperative; tends to focus on negative information, negate positive feedback, and personalize problems; able to reflect but with heavy self-doubt

basic_info.main_problem: Although I am good at hosting parties, almost nobody comes, which makes me feel lonely and sad. It started with a low-attendance event a few months ago; later events also had low attendance and the stress gradually increased; whenever I plan an event I expect low attendance and feel the same emotions.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of loneliness are affecting my mental health and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: A party a few months ago with very low attendance became a turning point: the stress level was moderate at the time, but afterward attendance at every event was low and the stress gradually rose; when preparing each event, the client would anticipate low attendance and feel loneliness and sadness; the client tried to improve things by promoting more actively on social media, contacting friends privately, and adjusting event plans, but with little effect; although work performance remained generally stable, interpersonal relationships struggled to form deeper connections; mood and motivation were affected, with difficulty getting up and self-care; the client has a few friends to talk to, but they are not always available, and the client worries about becoming a burden.

core_beliefs: I am not liked / not accepted
There is something wrong with me; I am not interesting enough; others will not choose me

special_situations.event: A party several months ago was attended by almost no one, and attendance at subsequent events remained low
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not come to my event, it means I am not interesting enough and there is something wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Promotes more actively on social media, contacts friends privately, and adjusts event content to increase appeal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like me; my events are not good enough

special_situations.event: Although few attended, those present reported 'having a great time' and gave positive evaluations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a high attendance rate counts as success; individual positive feedback does not mean I did well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evaluation, magnifying the shortfall in numbers, producing thoughts of quitting
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This does not count as success; I still failed

special_situations.event: When preparing a new event, recalling past experiences of low attendance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Low past attendance means it will be low in the future too, I will very likely fail again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering expectations in advance and increasing promotion to avoid being rejected again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Again no one will come this time; I am going to fail again

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be liked, recognized, and included (hopes others are willing to attend their events and build deeper connections)
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being rejected and disliked; afraid of failure being negated
defense_goal: By personalizing the poor attendance and negating positive feedback, lowers expectations in advance to reduce the pain of rejection
Reduces actively seeking support to avoid becoming a burden to others, thereby protecting the self

object_relations.self_representation: A lonely organizer easily rejected (doubting oneself is not interesting enough)
object_relations.object_representation: Others are a cold group unwilling to participate / unstable supporters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out external factors (such as time conflicts) or emphasize positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client experiences it as 'you do not understand my pain; this is mainly my problem'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Insists on attributing low attendance to themselves, in a calm but stubborn tone, using expressions such as 'the common factor is me / my events are not attractive enough' to maintain the cognition.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When it comes to seeking support from friends or expressing needs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes oneself to be a burden; others are unwilling to support oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses a self-blaming and guilty tone (such as 'it is all my problem, I should not trouble others'), lowering the sense of self-worth and weakening help-seeking behavior.

manifestations: Low event attendance triggers intense loneliness and sadness
Friends are not always present, worrying oneself becomes a burden and reducing help-seeking
Difficulty building deeper connections with others
outcomes: Difficulties with daily self-care and task execution

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: In low attendance situations, inferring 'they do not like me / do not want to come'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-doubt and self-denial (such as 'it is all my problem')
Mainly attributing insufficient attendance to one's own traits

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Worries about becoming a burden and reduces proactively seeking friends' support

positive_force: Has event-planning ability and receives positive feedback from attendees
Able to proactively take action (social media promotion, private invitations, adjusting plans)
Having a few friends to confide in who provide some support
negative_force: Negating positive feedback and mental filtering, over-focusing on low attendance
Personalizing problems, excessive self-blame and seeking external validation
Loneliness and sadness affect motivation and daily functioning
Anticipatory negative inferences (jumping to conclusions / mind reading) intensify anxiety during the preparation stage

target_behavior.behavior: Anticipatory anxiety and self-negation during the event-preparation stage (worrying about low attendance, believing they are not liked)
antecedent: Starting to plan or thinking about an upcoming event
回想过去低出席率的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizes the low attendance, seeks external validation to confirm self-worth, negates positive feedback, and jumps to conclusions (mind reading)
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of rejection and feelings of failure, protecting the self by lowering expectations in advance
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and decreased motivation, thoughts of quitting the profession arise, affecting daily task performance

target_behavior.behavior: Low mood leads to difficulties in daily self-care and task execution (difficulty getting up, basic self-care affected)
antecedent: During the preparation stage, anticipates failure and feels lonely and sad
target_behavior.core_reason: Long-term loneliness and damaged sense of self-worth; negating positive feedback intensifies powerlessness
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of facing the pain of failure and rejection
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work and life efficiency, difficulty maintaining stable self-care
